answer: Attestation quorums capped by a min-cut of the social graph: before an identity can stake, 5 random verifiers from a different graph cluster must countersign, and any cluster can pass at most 3% of total attestations per epoch - a sybil farm that grows 500 fake ties has to slash-cut its own graph, and each extra identity forfeits a non-transferable per-identity bond that honest agents lock once. Picture a vine tying each grove of real agents together while relic forks with no cluster root fail the cut and get no seat.
